description: Na₂MnFeF₇ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Imma space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to eight F atoms to form distorted NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent FeF₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent FeF₆ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent MnF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 52°. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.87 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted body-centered cubic geometry to eight F atoms. There are four shorter (2.57 Å) and four longer (2.86 Å) Na-F bond lengths. Mn is bonded to six F atoms to form MnF₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent MnF₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent FeF₆ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 41-53°. There are two shorter (2.09 Å) and four longer (2.12 Å) Mn-F bond lengths. Fe is bonded to six F atoms to form FeF₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids, corners with four equivalent MnF₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 41°. There are four shorter (1.94 Å) and two longer (2.00 Å) Fe-F bond lengths. There are three inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to three Na and one Fe atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FNa₃Fe tetrahedra. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mn, and one Fe atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Mn atoms.
